messages.author: 34876aae73051821
messages.subject: Re: Make a tree and phylogeny tree from  Multiple Sequences Alignment file (MSA .fasat file or MSA .phylip file)
parts: Do you mean you have an msa and you want to create a tree from it? I don't think ggtree can do that. First you need to create your phylogeny using any method of your preference (NJ, Bayesian, ML, etc) and once you have your tree (in .nwk format, for example, although many other formats are supported) then you can use ggtree to plot it.
